svg.title: HospitalSystem CI/CD pipeline
svg.desc: A push to main runs CI (build, test, Trivy scan), then Docker Image CI builds both images, tags them latest, date plus short SHA and full SHA, and pushes them to Amazon ECR and Docker Hub. Deploy to EKS waits for a reviewer, assumes an AWS role with OIDC and sends an SSM command to the ops instance, which patches the Deployments through the private EKS API. The AWS Load Balancer Controller serves the app at https://app.hospitalsyst.cc.
